# Mobile profiles

Jamf Pro **mobile-device** configuration profiles via Classic `/JSSResource/mobiledeviceconfigurationprofiles` (XML envelope). The offline payload pipeline — `profile_xml_extract_payloads`, `payloads_*`, `plist_*` — works on mobile profile XML exactly as it does for [computer profiles](/docs/docs/profiles).

## Agent rules

- Use `mobile_profile_xml` / `mobile_profile_put_xml` for mobile profiles — `profile_xml` / `profile_put_xml` hit the computer endpoint.
- Clone by fetching XML, running `profile_xml_prepare_for_create(xml, name)`, then `mobile_profile_create_xml`.

## Facts

- List: `mobile_profiles(filter?)` · `buddy mobile-profile list`
- Fetch XML: `mobile_profile_xml(id=…|name=…)` · `buddy mobile-profile get <profile-id>` — Classic envelope
- Save XML: `mobile_profile_put_xml(id, xml_str, redeploy?)` · `buddy mobile-profile put <profile-id> [--redeploy]`
- Create / delete: `mobile_profile_create_xml` / `mobile_profile_delete` · `buddy mobile-profile create|delete`
- Edit payloads: offline `profile_xml_*` / `payloads_*` helpers · — — Same helpers as computer profiles
- Classic XML API — the envelope wraps a payloads plist, same as computer profiles.
- `redeploy=True` sets `<redeploy_on_update>All</redeploy_on_update>` before the PUT.
- Offline helpers (`profile_xml_extract_payloads`, `profile_xml_patch_payload`, `payloads_*`) take XML strings and never call the API, so they work on mobile profile XML unchanged.

## Builtins

### mobile_profiles

List mobile profiles

Returns: list

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "filter": {
      "description": "name substring",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "title": "mobile_profiles",
  "type": "object"
}
```

### mobile_profile_xml

Fetch profile XML

Returns: str

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "description": "profile id",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "title": "mobile_profile_xml",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Examples

```python
def main():
    return mobile_profiles(filter="WiFi")
```

```python
def main():
    xml = mobile_profile_xml(name = "WiFi - Corp")
    xml = profile_xml_patch_payload(xml, identifier="com.apple.wifi.managed", new_payload={"SSID_STR": "Corp-New"})
    pid = mobile_profiles(filter="WiFi - Corp")[0]["id"]
    mobile_profile_put_xml(id = pid, xml_str = xml, redeploy = True)
```
